basis: Peak reduction of 50 kW, with energy for one to two hours at that power (Intilion: about 1C for peak shaving, 0.5C for self-consumption)
Self-consumption: about 1 kWh of usable storage per kWp of PV, so 120 kWh for 120 kWp (Voltfang)
These are indicative figures. Send us your 15-minute load profile and we size the system.
warnings: Above 30 kVA, VDE-AR-N 4105 requires central grid and system protection (NA-Schutz).
Above 135 kW the grid connection follows VDE-AR-N 4110.
Above 100,000 kWh a year your grid operator meters a 15-minute load profile; ask them for last year's data.
